domain_claim: Public Runtime::kill_run must exist and operate only on live runs; cancel/kill for missing/already-terminal returns typed errors.
model_boundary: Runtime::kill_run public API and shard handle_cancel/handle_kill validation.
notes: Fresh main lacks public kill_run; existing cancel/kill returns Ok(()) for missing/terminal runs.

domain_claim: Each run may append exactly one terminal journal event; duplicate cancel/kill after terminal is rejected.
model_boundary: Journal append path during terminal handling.

domain_claim: Cancel/kill invalidates stale timer/action/ask/resume authority so no later completion can mutate terminal run.
model_boundary: Shard authority tables and cancellation hooks.

domain_claim: Storage codec must admit RunKilled=28 as a known journal event kind on encode and decode; prior RecordKindFamilyMismatch is removed.
notes: Currently accepts only k 10-27; must add k=28.

domain_claim: Replay of runs with killed terminal must produce contiguous event ordinals matching actual append order.
